title: EAP: Handle EPC NAIs, extract MCC and MNC from 5G NAIs
description:
Various chapters of 3GPP TS 23.003 describe NAIs used for EAP:
14 (WLAN Interworking), 17 (GAN), 19 (EPC/LTE), 28 (5GCN).
All of them share the .mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org
part of the realm, GAN and EPC encode the IMSI similarly to WLAN;
the 5G system does not (also see RFC 9048 5.3 "Identifier Usage in 5G",
but it's still useful to extract the MCC and MNC in that case.
